en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a studio portrait of a family in elaborate traditional folk costume. A seated man in a decorated jacket, high boots and tall hat holds a pipe, flanked by a woman and two children wearing richly patterned dresses, aprons, shawls and head coverings. Below the photograph is a blank writing area with printed German captions and publisher information.
